cases.purpose: Observe fdvar through kernel PTY/session state in a live, handshaken child.
cases.oracle: An independent Python os.setsid and Linux TIOCSCTTY participant supplies the reference; the parent verifies /proc descriptors, session IDs, controlling-device identity and tcgetpgrp on the fixture-owned PTYs.
cases.comparison: Exact named predicates and status; bounded dynamic PID, FD, descriptor identities and raw child diagnostics are retained separately. The returned FD and independently statted slave device, inode and rdev are retained as raw values.
